idea-plugin.name: Tokyo Night
idea-plugin.description:
Tokyo Night brings all four variants of the popular Zed theme to IntelliJ IDEA, faithfully ported for the IDE.

Variants

  • Tokyo Night - deep navy dark (#1a1b26)
  • Tokyo Night Storm - softer slate dark (#24283b)
  • Tokyo Night Moon - cool indigo dark (#222436)
  • Tokyo Night Light - light companion (#d5d6db)

What's themed

  • Window chrome, toolbars and popups
  • Editor syntax highlighting across languages
  • Terminal ANSI colors in both classic and block terminals
  • Diff and VCS colors

Each variant ships its own editor scheme that applies automatically when you select the theme.

Highlights

  • A single source of truth driven by the upstream Zed palette
  • A native fit with the modern Islands UI
  • Supports IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2 and later

Based on ssaunderss/zed-tokyo-night (MIT). Source code and issue tracker: github.com/Jarvvski/tokyo-night-intellij
